clips.title: The story
paras: The Warrior's Terrace is the eastern district of Darnassus, acting as both a martial training hub and the capital's fortified gateway. Overlooking the road into greater Teldrassil, it houses the city's battlemasters, warrior trainers, and Sentinel patrols.

Positioned at the eastern threshold of Darnassus, the Warrior's Terrace—sometimes referred to as the Hall of Justice—stands as the primary defensive bulwark against incursions from the Teldrassil wilds. Heavily armed Sentinels mounted on nightsabers guard its high arched gates, maintaining a vigilant watch over incoming travelers. Within its open-air plazas, aspiring combatants drill alongside seasoned veterans on extensive dueling grounds and target ranges. The district also serves practical military needs, hosting weapon smiths, armorers, and the battlemasters coordinating night elf forces across the wider world.
